items.low: Lands behind the merge requests approved before it
items.high: Lands ahead of the merge requests approved before it
items.urgent: Lands ahead of everything else approved

items.hygiene: Improvements to repo hygiene such as linting

items.stub: Adds stubs to be implemented later
items.park: Adds 'parked' code; implemented code that is not yet integrated into active behavior
items.integrate: Wires previously stubbed or parked code into active behavior

items.experimental: Start a prerelease dev series for the next version
items.release: Promote any prerelease directly to stable

items.full-suite: Force the full test suite for this review, bypassing impacted-test selection

items.new: Changes in review that don't yet fit an existing repo area

items.bizdev: The conversation with a named prospect or client
items.delivery: Client engagement work after a signature
items.platform: The substrate: shellops, creatures, CI, the release chain
items.ktlo: Bugs, debt, CI and dependency breakage
items.research: Research lanes: an open question scoped before it is run, reviewed in Notion
items.shepherd: Approved merge requests, from approval until they land
items.unknown: No Linear issue named, or its hat is unset or disputed
